learner_operation: Identify P in y prime+Py=Q; compute I=exp(integral P), integrate IQ and impose the initial value. For constant P=a this legitimately simplifies to recognizing e^(a x), b=Q/a and C=h-b.

fixed_features.feature: Two selects, one for I and one for the particular y; four and five choices respectively
fixed_features.justification: The banked source questions request these quantities; a single correct candidate per field is the response contract.

fixed_features.feature: Easy constant P positive integer 1..6, Q=a b with positive b 1..6, initial point 0
fixed_features.justification: Conservative constant-coefficient practice grounded in source 9213a6d1 (P=1) and cba95378 (P=4). Changing a only changes an elementary exponential primitive, while Q=a b keeps arithmetic comparable. Other source families remain available at their source difficulty.

fixed_features.feature: Easy excludes h=0 and equilibrium C=0
fixed_features.justification: Explicitly bounded nondegenerate practice family retains IC and homogeneous-component discrimination with unambiguous banks; not asserted to be a mathematical necessity. These unchanged exclusions do not constrain a or the integrating-factor decision.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: a may change independently of b,h; correct option rank/position may vary
answer_roles.observed: All six a values, all four IF ranks and positions in 48 independent easy records. Former e^x cue succeeds 11/48.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: b,h may vary; C=h-b can be positive or negative; which solution candidate satisfies both conditions must follow
answer_roles.observed: Both C signs, both initial-value signs and all five solution positions. Held a=2,b=2 with h=-1 to 3 changes y while preserving I.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: d is distinct from a and both roles occur in the solution bank; extra-candidate slope can match either
answer_roles.observed: Repeated-slope strategy 28/48 after filtering versus 1/2 two-slope baseline; no perfect predictor in positive/negative initial-value subgroups.

coverage.result: All 5 accepted; coefficients 1,3,4 remain. The 5-record batch alone is not treated as full coverage.
a=2,b=2,h=-1 succeeds; all six forced coefficients pass retained check; same check demonstrably fails on old code. Boundary values 1,6 and h=-6,6 have independently verified keys.

15 proposals produce 12 records; rejected proposals are h=0 or h=b, not a-dependent suppression. Invalid a=0,7 and out-of-range h rejected. Six coefficients survive in the larger fresh delivered sample.

counterfactuals.change: With seed=27181,b=2,h=-1 fixed, change a=1 to 2 and then 6
counterfactuals.expected: P,Q,I,y and dependent solution expressions change coherently; I=e^(a x),y=2-3e^(-a x)
counterfactuals.observed: Exact math verifies changes; native grader accepts exactly the corresponding I,y in each bank; UI screenshots 1,2,3 show correct updated prompts and worked primitive 1/a.
counterfactuals.justification: Tutorial a6a381ed steps 1-5 depend on P; source constant coefficients 1 and 4 demonstrate coefficient assignment is incidental.

counterfactuals.expected: I preserved, C=-3 becomes 1, y changes from 2-3e^(-2x) to 2+e^(-2x)
counterfactuals.observed: Prompt, IC substitution, key and conclusion change together. All-choice native grading agrees with independent ODE+IC tests. Screenshots 2,4 confirm.
counterfactuals.justification: Initial condition selects the particular solution after integrating; it does not enter I.

counterfactuals.change: Hold a=2,b=2,h=-1; seed 27181 to 27182 changes distractors/order
counterfactuals.expected: Mathematical answers, prompt and worked solution preserved despite incidental bank/UUID changes
counterfactuals.observed: Both mathematical answers, prompt and worked solution are equal. All-choice grading uses each actual bank UUID. Screenshots 2,5 display the same mathematical response.
counterfactuals.justification: Source response is determined by the ODE and initial condition, independently of choice layout or distractor recipe.

shortcut_probes.strategy: Select e^(a x) by integrating constant P
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Baseline is 1/4 uniform IF guessing. Perfect coefficient-to-exponential matching performs the intended integrating-factor calculation.

stages_examined: actual publisher normalization and key/UUID rewriting
conditional within-easy learner selection and explicit history exclusions
delivery.result: 48/48 fresh and 5/5 runner records survive. Publisher changes IDs while preserving all prompts, solutions and ordered choices; native grader verifies rewritten key wiring. Fresh coverage/probe counts unchanged after delivery. Three 96-draw easy selection scenarios retain all six coefficients. Captured legacy bank remains separately affected; no database writes.

limitations: Targeted revision review: unchanged source-family validation reused only after nine current complete replays match earlier independent records exactly. Six non-easy authored examples provide a small math regression, not another exhaustive audit.

Captured inventory basis 5344 contains five previously demonstrated legacy easy shortcut records. They remain listed in affected-inventory.json with reproducible complete records; current package acceptance does not certify historical-bank cleanup.

Within-band selection is tested conditionally: actual live policy weights, histories, task seeds and new database IDs are unavailable. Synthetic new IDs define an explicit allocation scenario; uniform within-band support does not depend on that order.
Source q-334916 lacks original key/solution. Two source banks contain duplicate correct values; evidence-only replay retains these documented defects while ordinary authored banks reject ambiguity.
These finite tests do not prove absence of all possible shortcuts. Comparing candidate exponents to P is intended integrating-factor knowledge, not an incidental cue.
